rows.grounds: prior action leading to the main act

items.question: What ritual orientation and action enable the mantra-practitioner to destroy enemies through fire?
premises: The mantra-practitioner is oriented facing south.
The ritual action is performed in fire.
Enemies are the intended targets of the burning.
items.inference: By facing south and performing burning in fire, the mantra-practitioner effects the destruction of enemies.
items.plain_english: Facing south, the mantra-practitioner, having performed burning in the fire, should burn his enemies.
